interview.hardest_part: Boss fights requiring precise timing and pattern execution, particularly Moss Mother and Bell Beast, which demand reaction speeds incompatible with turn-based screenshot input
interview.likely_failure: Repeated deaths to enemies and environmental hazards due to the fundamental mismatch between real-time gameplay and turn-based control with 0.4-second action granularity, leading to inability to progress past early-to-mid game areas
interview.helpful_mechanics: Respawning at benches rather than full restart allows continued progress after deaths; exploration and scene discovery award points without requiring combat mastery; currency and kill tracking accumulate over time; can learn enemy patterns through repeated encounters
interview.harmful_mechanics: Real-time combat and platforming with turn-based input creates severe reaction time handicap; 0.4-second action holds are too coarse for precise jumps and dodges; visual-only feedback from screenshots limits awareness of timing windows; death penalty of returning to last bench wastes significant time in a 3-hour window; boss fights gate progress and require execution precision that screenshot-based play cannot deliver
